sentences.zh: 所以现在，突然之间，因为他们改变了系统，因为他们提高了灵敏度，

sentences.en: they're seeing a lot more intrusions or a lot more things that look like intrusions.
sentences.zh: 他们看到了更多的入侵，或者说更多看起来像入侵的东西。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Having this metaphorical vision of kind of a telescope where it's a little bit fuzzy, but the minute you keep sharpening it and turning it and adjusting it,
sentences.zh: 我们可以用望远镜做个隐喻，它一开始有点模糊，但只要你不断将其对焦、旋转和调整，

sentences.en: suddenly you're going to see everything a lot more clearly.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，你会把一切看得清楚得多。

sentences.en: You're going to see a lot more.
sentences.zh: 你会看到更多东西。

sentences.en: You're saying basically our entire system for looking out into the sky went through something similar, and we started to see a lot more and see it a lot more clearly.
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，基本上我们用来眺望天空的整个系统经历了一个类似的过程，我们开始看到更多，也看得更清楚了。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The radar, like your telescope analogy, can be tuned.
sentences.zh: 雷达就像你的望远镜比喻一样，是可以调节的。

sentences.en: They can pick up just the most important things, or they can pick up a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 它们可以只捕捉最重要的事情，也可以捕捉很多事情。

sentences.en: But when you change the sensitivity, you're going to get a lot more false positives, things that look important but really aren't.
sentences.zh: 但是当你改变灵敏度时，你会得到更多的误报，也就是那些看起来重要但实际上并不重要的东西。

sentences.en: So why then, if the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么为什么，如果美国

sentences.en: knows its system is more sensitive and therefore is going to be picking up a lot of stuff, some of which may matter, some of which might not,
sentences.zh: 知道其系统更灵敏，因此会捕捉到大量东西，其中有些可能重要，有些可能无关紧要，

sentences.en: are we deciding to shoot almost all those things out of the sky if some of them might be fairly harmless?
sentences.zh: 如果我们决定把几乎所有这些东西都从天上打下来，万一其中有些相当无害呢？

sentences.en: What exactly is the calculation there?
sentences.zh: 这背后的计算到底是什么？

sentences.en: I think the calculation may be somewhat different in each of the incidents,
sentences.zh: 我认为在每起事件中，背后的考量可能略有不同，

sentences.en: but what sort of unites them is an abundance of caution.
sentences.zh: 但将它们联系在一起的是一种极度的谨慎。

sentences.en: They do not want to let these things get away.
sentences.zh: 他们不想让这些东西溜走。

sentences.en: They want to take a look at them.
sentences.zh: 他们想看个究竟。

sentences.en: But to do that, you've got to take them out of the sky.
sentences.zh: 但要做到这一点，你必须把它们从天上打下来。

sentences.en: They also don't want to have a situation where if it is a Chinese surveillance device, that it can float over the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们也不希望出现这样的情况：如果这是一个中国的监视设备，它可以在美国

sentences.en: or Canada for any length of time.
sentences.zh: 或加拿大上空漂浮相当长的一段时间。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And at the same time, though, it seems kind of hard to divorce this decision-making from the reality that when it came to that first Chinese spy balloon,
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，似乎很难将这一决策与现实脱节：当谈到第一个中国间谍气球时，

sentences.en: President Biden and his administration was very heavily criticized, mostly by Republican lawmakers and even some Democrats,
sentences.zh: 拜登总统及其政府受到了极其猛烈的批评，主要来自共和党议员甚至一些民主党人，

sentences.en: for letting it not just enter our airspace but stay in our airspace, float over state after state after state.
sentences.zh: 因为他们不仅让气球进入了我们的领空，还让它留在我们的领空，在接连不断的州上空漂浮。

sentences.en: In your conversations with people in the military and in the intelligence community, is there an acknowledgment that that dynamic has changed as well?
sentences.zh: 在与军方和情报界人士的交谈中，是否有人承认这种动态也发生了变化？

sentences.en: Well, look, people in the military and in the intelligence agencies
sentences.zh: 嗯，你看，军方和情报机构的人

sentences.en: wanted to keep looking at that first Chinese spy balloon.
sentences.zh: 原本想继续观察那个中国的间谍气球。

sentences.en: They thought that observing it over time and then taking it down when it was over water was both the best for intelligence collection and the safest for people on the ground.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，随着时间的推移观察它，然后在它飞到水面上空时将其击落，既有利于情报收集，又对地面人员最安全。

sentences.en: But there's no doubt that that decision opened the White House and President Biden up for criticism.
sentences.zh: 但毫无疑问，这一决定让白宫和拜登总统招致了批评。

sentences.en: So all these other objects have come into that political environment where there is now a bias toward action.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些其他物体都进入了这样一个政治环境，在这里现在有一种采取行动的倾向。

sentences.en: There's a bias toward taking them down.
sentences.zh: 有一种将其击落的倾向。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which might not have existed in the absence of that political pressure.
sentences.zh: 如果没有这种政治压力，这种倾向可能原本并不存在。

sentences.en: But regardless of the motivation, it feels like shooting every object that crosses into our airspace out of the sky, which is the precedent we have created here,
sentences.zh: 但不管动机如何，把每一个飞入我们领空的物体都从天上打下来，这正是我们在这里开创的先例，

sentences.en: could get pretty complicated and pretty dangerous pretty faSt.
sentences.zh: 这可能会变得相当复杂，而且非常危险，速度会非常快。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: I mean, we're taking very expensive aircraft with very sophisticated missiles and shooting them at things that we don't even know what they are.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们正用非常昂贵的飞机和高度复杂的导弹，向我们甚至不知道是什么的东西开火。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, there's all kinds of dangers in that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，其中存在着各种各样的危险。

sentences.en: Dangers, you know, that there could be an accident, that the missile could miss.
sentences.zh: 你知道的危险包括可能会发生事故，导弹可能会射偏。

sentences.en: So it's really important to figure out what these things are pretty quickly so we do not just go for days and days
sentences.zh: 因此，非常迅速地弄清楚这些东西是什么真的很重要，这样我们就不会一连好几天

sentences.en: taking down every radar blip that appears over Montana or Lake Michigan.
sentences.zh: 击落在蒙大拿州或密歇根湖上空出现的每一个雷达回波。

sentences.en: But there would seem to be another significant way in which this could get dangerous, Julian, and that's if the United States has similar devices over a place like China.
sentences.zh: 但朱利安，这似乎还有另一种重大方式会变得危险，那就是如果美国在类似中国的地方也有相似的设备。

sentences.en: And by doing what we have done over the past week, we are now encouraging our rivals to shoot down our spying devices, if they are spying devices.
sentences.zh: 通过我们在过去一周所做的事情，我们现在正鼓励我们的对手击落我们的间谍设备，如果它们是间谍设备的话。

sentences.en: And so are we entering any kind of tit-for-tat cycle that could escalate if we have comparable devices out in the world?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果我们世界上有可比的设备，我们是否正在进入任何可能升级的针锋相对的循环？

sentences.en: It's a rule of spycraft that what one country does to another is then reciprocated, right?
sentences.zh: 间谍活动的规则是，一个国家对另一个国家做什么，就会得到相应的回报，对吧？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So if you shoot down a spy balloon, well, they're going to be looking for a spy balloon to shoot down.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你击落了一个间谍气球，好吧，他们就会寻找一个间谍气球来击落。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: The key thing you don't want to do is you don't want to escalate, right?
sentences.zh: 你最不想做的一件关键事情就是不想让事态升级，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, I shoot down your spy balloon, you take down my satellite.
sentences.zh: 比如，我击落了你的间谍气球，你拿下了我的卫星。

sentences.en: Well, that's a different precedent.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那是另一个先例。

sentences.en: You've all of a sudden risked not stabilizing the situation, but making it far worse.
sentences.zh: 你突然面临的风险不是稳定局势，而是让情况变得更糟。

sentences.en: But to go back to that question, does the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但回到那个问题，美国

sentences.en: have comparable devices over a place like China that will quite likely invite this reciprocation you just described?
sentences.zh: 在类似中国的地方是否有可比的设备，从而很可能会招致你刚才描述的这种报复？

sentences.en: The honest answer for me is we do not completely know.
sentences.zh: 我诚实的回答是，我们并不完全知道。

sentences.en: China has alleged that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 中国声称美国

sentences.en: has a program to send spy balloons over its territory, and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 有一个在其领土上空发送间谍气球的项目，而美国

sentences.en: says that's completely false.
sentences.zh: 表示这完全是捏造。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: You know, for the most part, the United States keeps its spying way up in space with satellites and just on the edge of international waters with our reconnaissance planes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在大多数情况下，美国将其间谍活动保持在太空中，通过卫星进行，并在我们的侦察机的国际水域边缘进行。

sentences.en: We have spy blimps, the J-lens, and we'll not put them in your territory.
sentences.zh: 我们有间谍飞艇，即J-lens，我们不会把它们放在你们的领土上。

sentences.en: We'll put them just outside your territory.
sentences.zh: 我们会把它们放在你们领土之外的地方。

sentences.en: So, we don't know exactly what the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们并不确切知道美国

sentences.en: sends over China.
sentences.zh: 派往中国上空的是什么。

sentences.en: What we do know is that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，美国

sentences.en: is trying to avoid entering their territory, confining their activities just to their borders or satellites in space.
sentences.zh: 正试图避免进入其领土，将他们的活动限制在他们的边界或太空中的卫星上。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: Which means that if China were to try to reciprocate, it might need to escalate.
sentences.zh: 这意味着如果中国试图报复，它可能需要升级。

sentences.en: That's the risk.
sentences.zh: 这就是风险。

sentences.en: That's the danger.
sentences.zh: 这就是危险所在。

sentences.en: So, Julian, where does this all end?
sentences.zh: 那么，朱利安，这一切将如何收场？

sentences.en: Does it even ever end?
sentences.zh: 它甚至会结束吗？

sentences.en: Because it looks now like we're on path to keep shooting down an object we see that might or might not be a spying device from a foreign country like China.
sentences.zh: 因为现在看起来我们正走在这样一条道路上：继续击落我们看到的可能是也可能不是来自中国等外国的间谍设备的物体。

sentences.en: Is your sense that right now there is a kind of shoot-to-kill order on these objects if they enter our airspace?
sentences.zh: 你的直觉是，现在如果这些物体进入我们的领空，就存在一种格杀勿论的命令吗？

sentences.en: To get past this moment, we have to figure out what these objects are.
sentences.zh: 为了度过这个时刻，我们必须弄清楚这些物体是什么。

sentences.en: And once we figure that out, we can readjust what we're doing.
sentences.zh: 一旦我们弄清楚了这一点，我们就可以重新调整我们的做法。

sentences.en: We can either learn which ones are surveillance devices and dangerous and which ones are trash, or maybe they're all trash and we can ignore them all.
sentences.zh: 我们要么了解哪些是监视设备而且危险，哪些是垃圾，或者也许它们都是垃圾，我们可以把它们全都不予理睬。

sentences.en: But until we learn about each of these incidents, we're going to be possibly trapped in this cycle of sending up fighter jets and shooting things that we don't understand.
sentences.zh: 但在我们了解每一次事件之前，我们可能都会陷入这个循环中：派出战斗机，击落我们不理解的东西。

sentences.en: And nobody should feel particularly comfortable when the Air Force is flying and shooting down stuff that they don't know what it is.
sentences.zh: 当空军飞行并击落他们不知道是什么的东西时，任何人都不应该感到特别舒服。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So are we talking days here, weeks, months of us needing to get to the bottom of that and therefore taking down objects day after day after day?
sentences.zh: 所以我们说的是需要几天、几周、几个月的时间来查明真相，因此日复一日地击落物体？

sentences.en: Well, the four objects we've shot down have all landed in difficult places to get to.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们击落的四个物体都降落在很难到达的地方。

sentences.en: One is under the ocean off South Carolina.
sentences.zh: 一个在南卡罗来纳州海岸外的海洋深处。

sentences.en: One is on frozen ice in the Arctic Ocean.
sentences.zh: 一个在北冰洋的冻冰上。

sentences.en: One is in a remote area of the Yukon Territory.
sentences.zh: 一个在育空地区的偏远地区。

sentences.en: And the last one is underneath a great lake.
sentences.zh: 最后一个在一个五大湖的湖底。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So it's going to take some time for divers and military personnel to get to this and see if there's anything they can collect.
sentences.zh: 因此，潜水员和军事人员需要花一些时间才能到达那里，看看有什么东西可以收集。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But that said, this is a top priority of the FBI, of the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，这是联邦调查局和五角大楼的重中之重。

sentences.en: And so I think we're going to have answers in days and not weeks.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们将在几天内而不是几周内得到答案。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: But in the meantime, if you're the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，如果你是美国

sentences.en: military, you are hoping that shooting these objects down sends a very strong message to the world that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 军方，你希望击落这些物体能向世界发出一个非常强烈的信号：美国

sentences.en: has zero tolerance when it comes to these kinds of incursions.
sentences.zh: 在面对这类入侵时采取零容忍态度。

sentences.en: So does that discourage rivals like China from sending a balloon ever again into our airspace?
sentences.zh: 那么这是否会阻止像中国这样的对手再次向我们的领空发送气球？

sentences.en: And if that's the case, is it a worthwhile outcome of having shot down these objects?
sentences.zh: 如果是这样的话，击落这些物体是一个值得的结果吗？

sentences.en: That's a good point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个好问题。

sentences.en: If you were confused before this month about whether the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果你在这个月之前还搞不清楚美国

sentences.en: would mind if you sent a spy balloon over its territory, you've got your answer now.
sentences.zh: 是否会在意你在其领土上空发送间谍气球，你现在得到答案了。

sentences.en: Like, do not do that.
sentences.zh: 就像，别这么做。

sentences.en: I mean, look, there was a situation where the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看，曾几何时，美国

sentences.en: was unaware of a lot of this activity.
sentences.zh: 对其中的许多活动并不知情。

sentences.en: Or when it became aware, it decided it was going to watch it and not destroy it.
sentences.zh: 或者当它意识到时，它决定去观察它而不是摧毁它。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And so maybe the Chinese thought that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以也许中国人认为美国

sentences.en: was going to tolerate some of this intrusion.
sentences.zh: 会容忍这种入侵。

sentences.en: But we're past that point now.
sentences.zh: 但我们已经过了那个节点了。

sentences.en: We are reinforcing this principle that you cannot come into our airspace uninvited and that we will defend it.
sentences.zh: 我们正在强化这样一个原则：你不能未经邀请就进入我们的领空，我们将捍卫它。

sentences.en: And so if you didn't have the message, you got it now.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你之前没收到这个信息，你现在收到了。

sentences.en: Well, Julian, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，朱利安，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们对此表示感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Monday, after we spoke with Julian, a spokesman for the Biden administration said that the three objects shot down by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周一，在我们与朱利安交谈后，拜登政府的一位发言人表示，美国

sentences.en: military since Friday lacked communication signals or the ability to maneuver themselves.
sentences.zh: 军方自周五以来击落的三个物体缺乏通信信号或机动能力。

sentences.en: But the spokesman, John Kirby, deflected questions about whether President Biden has created a new policy for when to shoot down such objects.
sentences.zh: 但发言人约翰·柯比迴避了关于拜登总统是否为何时击落此类物体制定了新政策的问题。

sentences.en: Where we go from here, he said, we just don't know.
sentences.zh: 他说，至于我们接下来要去向何方，我们只是不知道。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能得到什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用程序并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: America's latest mass shooting occurred at the campus of Michigan State University, where a gunman killed at least three people and injured five others.
sentences.zh: 美国最新的一起大规模枪击事件发生在密歇根州立大学校园内，一名枪手在那里杀害了至少三人并打伤了另外五人。

sentences.en: The shooting comes on the fifth anniversary of another school shooting at the Marjory Stoneman
sentences.zh: 这次枪击事件发生在美国佛罗里达州玛乔丽·斯通曼

sentences.en: Douglas High School in Florida, where 17 people were killed.
sentences.zh: 道格拉斯高中另一场校园枪击案五周年纪念日之际，那场枪击案造成17人死亡。

sentences.en: And the Times reports that Congressman George Santos of New York, who has admitted to lying
sentences.zh: 据《时报》报道，纽约州国会议员乔治·桑托斯承认自己在

sentences.en: about much of his resume, failed to account for how he used more than $365,000 in campaign funds.
sentences.zh: 大部分简历上撒了谎，却无法解释他如何使用了超过36.5万美元的竞选资金。

sentences.en: Experts on campaign finance said that a failure to document spending on that scale, 12% of
sentences.zh: 竞选财务专家表示，未能记录如此规模的支出，占其

sentences.en: his campaign spending, represented remarkably sloppy bookkeeping and the absence of campaign finance controls.
sentences.zh: 竞选支出的12%，代表着极其糟糕的簿记工作以及缺乏竞选财务控制。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Mooj Zadie, Will Reed, and Diana Wynn.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由穆吉·扎迪、威尔·里德和黛安娜·温制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester, contains original music by Marion Lozano and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由蕾切尔·克斯特编辑，包含马里昂·洛萨诺和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德进行工程制作。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landfork of Wonderland.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题曲由吉姆·布伦伯格和仙境的本·兰福克创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上是本期《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线敏感吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到不省人事才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是指，他们需要什么样的光线环境？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏史或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们习惯喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
